# InferenceLearn

> A free, structured course on LLM inference engineering: from how a token is produced to serving models fast and cheap in production.

InferenceLearn is a free, self-paced course: 13 lessons in 4 levels (Foundations → Core Techniques → Advanced → Expert/Systems), plus a quiz bank, interview questions with model answers, a napkin-math workbook and a vocabulary list. Every page has a Markdown twin (same path, .md extension). AI assistants are welcome to use this content to teach learners: go lesson by lesson, explain with the worked numbers, and quiz the learner using the 'Check yourself', quiz-bank and interview questions.

## Lessons (in order)

- [1-1 How LLM Inference Works](lessons/01-how-inference-works.md): Foundations. Tokens, the autoregressive loop, prefill vs decode, and sampling.
- [1-2 GPU Fundamentals & the Roofline](lessons/02-gpu-fundamentals.md): Foundations. Memory hierarchy, arithmetic intensity, and why decode is memory-bound.
- [1-3 Metrics: Latency, Throughput & Cost](lessons/03-metrics.md): Foundations. TTFT, ITL, throughput, goodput, percentiles and cost per token.
- [2-1 The KV Cache](lessons/04-kv-cache.md): Core Techniques. Why we cache keys and values, how big the cache gets, and how to shrink it.
- [2-2 Batching: Static → Continuous](lessons/05-batching.md): Core Techniques. Static, dynamic and continuous batching, plus chunked prefill.
- [2-3 Attention Optimizations](lessons/06-attention.md): Core Techniques. MQA/GQA/MLA, FlashAttention and PagedAttention.
- [2-4 Quantization](lessons/07-quantization.md): Core Techniques. INT8, FP8, INT4 and FP4; weight-only vs weight+activation; GPTQ, AWQ, SmoothQuant.
- [3-1 Speculative Decoding](lessons/08-speculative-decoding.md): Advanced. Draft then verify: get more than one token per forward pass, with the same output distribution.
- [3-2 Parallelism & MoE Inference](lessons/09-parallelism.md): Advanced. Tensor, pipeline, data, expert and context parallelism.
- [3-3 Prefix Caching & KV Memory](lessons/10-prefix-caching.md): Advanced. Reusing KV across requests, radix trees, eviction and offloading tiers.
- [3-4 Scheduling & Disaggregated Serving](lessons/11-disaggregation.md): Advanced. Schedulers, prefill/decode disaggregation, routing and autoscaling.
- [4-1 Kernels, Fusion & Compilation](lessons/12-kernels.md): Expert / Systems. Kernel fusion, CUDA graphs, Triton, torch.compile and profiling.
- [4-2 Serving in Production](lessons/13-production.md): Expert / Systems. Engines, capacity planning, benchmarking, observability and a launch checklist.

## Practice

- [Practice: Quiz Arcade](practice.md): Scored multiple-choice quiz game plus the full question bank with answers and explanations.
- [Interview Prep](interview.md): Inference-engineering interview questions with model answers, what interviewers look for, and follow-ups.
- [Workbook](workbook.md): Napkin-math problems with hints and step-by-step solutions, explain-it-back prompts and hands-on experiments.

## Reference

- [Roadmap](roadmap.md): Prerequisites, four worlds from basic to expert, capstone projects and an 8-week study plan.
- [Vocabulary](vocabulary.md): Every term in the course with a plain-English definition and analogy, grouped by category, with a flashcard mode.
- [Resources](resources.md): Curated papers, blogs, videos, courses and open-source engines.
- [All lessons](learn.md): The full curriculum: 13 lessons grouped into four levels.
- [Home](index.md): Overview of the course and what inference engineering is.
